scope: Hermes/NAVE only; human-gated; no OpenClaw; no live trading

experiments.hypothesis: Meaningful launches contain recurring trajectory families that may require distinct policies
experiments.mechanism: Empirical normalized path structure, not pre-labeled Burst/Runner classes
experiments.data_source: PumpApi complete historical launch panel; public corpus discovery only
experiments.data_exclusions: documented corpus issues; preserve all DEAD/UNEXITABLE/UNKNOWN/right-censored records
experiments.features: price, quoted mcap, liquidity, reserves, real volume, buyers/sellers, new/returning buyers, concentration, drawdown, protocol state
experiments.falsification_conditions: families unstable across chronological blocks or not economically recognizable

experiments.hypothesis: Organic new-buyer absorption after a relative sell shock improves 15m–60m executable outcomes
experiments.mechanism: sell shock followed by independent breadth and intact liquidity
experiments.data_source: PumpApi event panel; independent replication required
experiments.data_exclusions: protocol-generated flow, System Program, corrupt/missing SOL rows, unknown execution state not passed
experiments.features: relative sell shock, recovery 30/60/120s, new buyers, cohort turnover, cluster share, flow entropy, liquidity recovery, creator flow
experiments.falsification_conditions: no baseline lift after costs, regime instability, or loss dependent on omitting dead/unexitable cases

experiments.hypothesis: Sustained runners show buyer replacement and market-quality retention as valuation expands
experiments.mechanism: new independent capital, stable liquidity/depth, repeated sell-shock survival
experiments.data_exclusions: peak-only labels, protocol flow, censored horizons, suspect supply/concentration rows
experiments.features: new-buyer share, participant entropy, cluster share, liquidity/mcap, volume/mcap, exit impact, sell-shock survival
experiments.exit_family: raw conditional returns first; fixed 4/8/24/48h and simple trailing/quality exits only if entry information survives
experiments.falsification_conditions: peak market cap fails to separate quality; no out-of-sample information; positive P&L from top 1–5 only

experiments.hypothesis: Point-in-time presence/convergence of historically informative independent participants adds information beyond token features
experiments.mechanism: participant arrival may be early confirmation of a past-only market transition; not copying
experiments.data_source: trade-level PumpApi/public corpus discovery, then independent on-chain replication
experiments.data_exclusions: creator-linked, funded/co-buying, bundle/sybil/coordinated clusters; System Program; unknown identity remains flagged
experiments.features: discovery skill, realized P&L, timing/exit quality, sample size/shrinkage, convergence, token×participant interactions
experiments.entry_event: first informative participant buy and convergence windows 30/60/300s
experiments.exit_family: separate Burst and Runner policies; no wallet copying or autonomous notification
experiments.falsification_conditions: no incremental lift over token-only model, activity-matched placebo parity, latency decay, or one-address dependence

experiments.hypothesis: Organic demand that persists after protocol-generated BOOST flow ends is more informative than raw post-migration demand
experiments.mechanism: exclude boost-buy-and-burn volume and reassess organic breadth/liquidity after the mechanical window
experiments.data_source: historically classified PumpSwap transaction/instruction events plus independent replication
experiments.data_exclusions: unverified BOOST mechanics/timing, protocol-generated trades, missing pool state
experiments.features: protocol share, organic buyers, post-BOOST retention, liquidity, sell absorption
experiments.exit_family: Fast Burst and Runner heads evaluated separately

parameters_tested.boost_end_window: not frozen until historical rollout/mechanics are independently verified

experiments.falsification_conditions: organic residual demand does not improve discrimination over matched post-migration controls
experiments.decision: Defer; no BOOST-derived feature in a signal
